title: A Study of ELVN-001 Versus Investigator-Selected TKI, in CP-CML Previously Treated With One or More TKIs
official: A Phase 3, Multicenter, Open-Label, Randomized Study of ELVN-001 Versus Investigator-Selected Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitor (TKI) of Dasatinib, Nilotinib, or Bosutinib, in Adult Participants With Chronic Myeloid Leukemia in Chronic Phase (CP-CML), Previously Treated With One or More TKIs
summary: The study is designed to compare the efficacy of ELVN-001 versus Investigator-selected tyrosine kinase inhibitor (TKI) for adults with previously treated chronic myeloid leukemia in the chronic phase (CP-CML). The Investigator-selected TKI will be one of the following standard of care therapies: Dasatinib, Nilotinib, or Bosutinib.
conditions: Chronic Myeloid Leukemia (CML) Philadelphia Chromosome Positive
Chronic Phase Chronic Myeloid Leukemia, BCR::ABL1 Positive CML
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male or female at least 18 years of age
* Diagnosis of chronic myeloid leukemia in chronic phase (CP-CML)
* Prior treatment with 1 or more BCR::ABL1 TKI(s)
* Failure or intolerance on the immediate prior TKI
* Adequate end organ function as measured by blood tests

Exclusion Criteria:

* Known T315I mutation
* Known second chronic phase of CML after previous progression to accelerated or blast phase
* Any serious or uncontrolled medical disorder
* QT interval corrected by Fridericia's formula (QTcF) ≥ 470 msec
* Previous treatment with a hematopoietic stem-cell transplantation
